== Example Question ==
Can you answer this question?

WHAT TWO LET'''T'''ERS ARE MISS'''I'''NG HERE?
 EVERYTHING THAT IS SUPPOSED TO BE HERE IS HERE.
The eye is drawn to the part of the question that is in yellow, so sometimes we ignore the actual question.

== 90% ==
Which one of these photographs has to be wrong?

[[File:Traffic light.png|frameless]]

'''B''': It should be a red light at the top of a traffic light

== 80% ==
Which letter of the alphabet appears in the spelling of every single odd number?

On'''e''' Thr'''ee''' Fiv'''e''' S'''e'''v'''e'''n Nin'''e''' El'''e'''v'''e'''n…

== 70% ==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |If you toss a normal coin four times and it lands heads up each time, what are the chances it will land heads up next time?
|-
|20%
|'''50%'''
|10%
|25%
|}
As there are only two options it will always be 50%.

== 60% ==
Which flower would logically come next in this sequence?

[[File:Flower.png|frameless]]

'''D''': The sequence of flowers goes from three petals to four petals to five petals to six petals, so the flower with seven petals has to be the answer.

== 50% ==
‘A’ is the first capital letter in the alphabet that looks the same in the mirror. What is the second?

'''H'''

== 45% ==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |Which of these is not doing what it says?
|-
|FORWARD
|''UNDERLINED''
|SDRAWKCAB
|'''BOLD'''
|}
''UNDERLINED'' is in italics instead of being <u>UNDERLINED</u>

== 40% ==
If you were singing ‘Happy Birthday’ to somebody named Happy, how many times would you sing the word ‘Happy’?

'''HAPPY''' birthday to you, '''HAPPY''' birthday to you, '''HAPPY''' birthday dear '''HAPPY''', '''HAPPY''' birthday to you.

== 35% ==
You are about to see 11 different pictures flashing up on-screen. Which is the middle picture?

Currently, the actual images are unavailable, but they are:

# Roasted chicken
# Maths teacher
# Bicycle
# Tree
# Rocket
# '''Cottage'''
# Birthday cake
# Playing cards
# Dog
# Ladder
# Sun

== 30% ==
January, July and October all have 31 days, but which of these months is the longest?

The clocks go back in '''October''' meaning it has an extra hour.

== 25% ==
Which legendary figure is written in code below?

HO'''ROB'''OD

Robin Hood

== 20% ==
What is the only letter of the alphabet missing from this extremely tricky and devious quiz question?

'''J'''

== 15% ==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |Which of these is the odd one out?
|-
|H & S
|C & Y
|P & A
|'''T & E'''
|}
If you replace the & with the word ‘and’ you create the words ‘hands’, ‘candy’ and ‘panda’. However, there is no such word as ‘tande’.

== 10% ==
What is the longest word in this question that does not contain any letters from the word “MACKEREL”?

‘This’, ‘is’, ‘in’ and ‘not’ don’t contain letters that are in the word “Mackerel”, but ‘'''this'''’ is the longest.
